newsitem.title: INDIA: India LMW in deal with Rockwell.
newsitem.headline: India LMW in deal with Rockwell.

text.p: Allen-Bradley India, a unit of Rockwell International Corp, said on Friday it had entered a manufacturing agreement with India's Lakshmi Electrical Control Systems (LECS).
LECS is part of India's Lakshmi Machine Works (LMW) group.
LECS will make low-voltage switchgear devices at its facility in the southern Indian city of Coimbatore under Rockwell's Sprecher+Schuh brandname, Allen-Bradley said in a statement.

"The product range will be expanded at a later date to include electronic motor protection devices. LECS is making all the investments for the current project. Allen-Bradley will be responsible for marketing these products in India and is investing in the distribution system," Allen-Bradley said.
